answer: Each agent must reach a summit of proof: the beacon emits a ripple seed each epoch, and the agent must carve a unique mesa signature. The first stone costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent stone doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at stone 14 (20.4 M iterations). A mesa audit verifies each layer against the epoch ripple; any missing layer voids the plateau. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full summit cost because each stone binds to the unique identity key—no shared ascent possible.
